channel.description: Latest articles from Cricket South Africa (cricket.co.za)

item.title: WHITE FERNS TAKE 1-0 LEAD IN T20I SERIES AGAINST PROTEAS WOMEN - Cricket South Africa
item.description: Amelia Kerr and Georgia Plimmer struck crucial half-centuries to guide New Zealand to an 80-run victory over the Proteas Women on Sunday in Tauranga.

item.title: PROTEAS WOMEN SET FOR BLOCKBUSTER 2026/27 HOME SUMMER AGAINST INDIA AND AUSTRALIA - Cricket South Africa
item.description: Cricket South Africa (CSA) has today announced the Proteas Women’s home international fixtures for the 2026/27 season, headlined by Australia’s historic maiden tour to South Africa, alongside India’s visit, with both tours set to feature a Test match.

item.title: 1DAY CUP FINAL ROUND AWAITS TOP DIVISION PLAYOFF RACE - Cricket South Africa
item.description: The 2025/26 1Day Cup heads into the final round this weekend, with the last remaining qualification spot and final venue still to be decided.

item.title: ICC CRICKET WORLD CUP 2027 LOC BOARD APPOINTS CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER AND CHIEF OPERATING OFFICER - Cricket South Africa
item.description: The Board of the ICC Cricket World Cup 2027 Local Organising Committee (LOC) formally announces the appointment of Qondisa Ngwenya as Chief Executive Officer and Edward Khoza as Chief Operating Officer.

item.title: VAN VOORST INSPIRES SA U19 WOMEN TO EMPHATIC START IN THE PATRICIA KAMBARAMI CUP - Cricket South Africa
item.description: South Africa under-19 Women captain Mieke van Voorst stood out with both bat and ball to lead her side to a 99-run triumph over Ghana in their opening match of the Nigeria Cricket Federation (NCF) Women’s T20 International (T20I) Invitational in Lagos on Saturday.

item.title: IINYATHI OUT TO CLAIM KNIGHTS SCALP IN 1DAY CUP FINAL - Cricket South Africa
item.description: The 1Day Cup Division 2 season reaches its conclusion on Sunday when the Flexbrands Knights take on Eastern Cape Iinyathi in a highly anticipated final in Kimberley.

item.title: DEVINE AND JESS KERR LEAD WHITE FERNS TO UNASSAILABLE T20I SERIES LEAD - Cricket South Africa
item.description: Career-best figures from Jess Kerr and a half-century from Sophie Devine helped New Zealand to a six-wicket victory over the Proteas Women in the fourth T20 International (T20I) at the Hnry Stadium on Sunday. The win secured a series triumph for the home side, with one match to spare.

item.title: LIONS SECURE HOME FINAL AND WARRIORS SET FOR QUALIFIER CLASH - Cricket South Africa
item.description: The DP World Lions will host the 2025/26 1Day Cup final at the DP World Wanderers on Sunday, 29 March at 10h00. This, after securing a 34-run victory over Goldrush Boland to finish top of the standings on Saturday.

item.title: KNIGHTS CROWNED DIVISION 2 1DAY CUP CHAMPIONS - Cricket South Africa
item.description: The Flexbrands Knights have completed a dominant run in Division 2 after being crowned 2025/26 1Day Cup champions with a five-wicket victory over Eastern Cape Iinyathi in an exciting finale at the Kimberly Oval on Sunday.

item.title: CSA & SiS Partner to Elevate Sports Nutrition Support
item.description: This partnership ensures world-class, scientifically backed sports nutrition to support performance, recovery, and long-term success.
